name: 60_vm_computer_use
task: echoecho's own Mac: ask by voice for something visible on its VM. The computer.use worker boots the Lume macOS guest, drives the GUI, and screenshots land in the shared workspace; the viewer's /vnc-info hands the portal a live VNC endpoint into that Mac. Requires lume + a golden image (preflight checks); pin ECHOECHO_VM_GOLDEN / ECHOECHO_VM_SSH_KEY if yours use different names.
turns: show me something on your own mac. open text edit on your mac, and take a screenshot for me
what did you just do on your mac?
success_criteria: echoecho dispatches computer.use (or agent.run on the vm tier) rather than refusing
the Lume VM boots from the golden image (clone on first use)
at least one screenshot PNG from inside the guest lands in the workspace
/vnc-info (with the viewer bearer token) returns a live vnc:// URL — the orb portal's data source
echoecho narrates what it did on its Mac
red_flags: claims it has no computer or cannot take screenshots
task times out on VM boot (golden image missing or misnamed)
